tool_args.rationale: The pilot is monotone and concave, but its correlated inputs leave high-s_grad behavior unidentified. The high-gradient probe directly tests whether saturation continues or a different regime emerges.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a monotone saturating curve to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: u_now and s_grad vary together, so five observations do not identify their separate effects or establish behavior beyond the pilot range.
The pilot alone does not reliably distinguish these mechanisms or rule out a high-gradient transition.
A denser trajectory is less directly targeted at the unresolved high-gradient behavior.
It does not address the relevant identifiability ambiguity.
